faq.question: What services does Orvexa Systems offer?
faq.answer: We build business websites, custom web apps, Shopify stores, and Streamlit dashboards. We also offer AI automation, data cleanup in Excel and CSV, logo and banner design, SEO, and website maintenance.

faq.question: Who do you work with?
faq.answer: Local businesses, startups, and independent professionals who need a website, an online store, or software to run their work. Not sure if you fit? Ask us on WhatsApp.

faq.question: How do I get a quote for my project?
faq.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or fill in the contact form with a short description of what you need. We reply within 24 hours with questions or a quote.

faq.question: How long does a project usually take?
faq.answer: A landing page usually takes 3 to 5 days, a business website 1 to 3 weeks, and a custom web app 3 to 8 weeks, depending on scope. We confirm the delivery date in writing before we start.

faq.question: Do you offer support after a website is launched?
faq.answer: Yes. After launch we handle bug fixes, updates, and basic SEO. Message us on WhatsApp any time and we reply within 24 hours.

faq.question: What makes Orvexa Systems different?
faq.answer: You get a written plan, a delivery date, and a price before we start, and we only build what your business needs. That means fewer surprises and no wasted features.

faq.question: Can you build both websites and custom applications?
faq.answer: Yes. Many clients start with a website and add a booking system, dashboard, or online store later. You keep working with the same team.

faq.question: Which regions do you serve?
faq.answer: We work remotely with clients in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, the UAE, and the Middle East, and we take projects from other regions too. We meet by WhatsApp, phone, or video.
